briefdescription.para: Reads one file, and builds its diff only when the pattern has a candidate in the file.

detaileddescription.para: A binary file gives the binary status. A file without a candidate gives no replacement.

parameterdescription.para: The file to read.
The display path of the file.
True when the file was named on the command line.

simplesect.para: The result, and the replacement when the file has one.

briefdescription.para: Builds one change for each line that has a match, within the line range.

detaileddescription.para: The candidate search skips the lines that cannot match. Each replaced line is one change of one line. The loop stops at the first candidate past the end of the line range.

parameterdescription.para: The document to diff.
Byte offset of the first candidate line of the document, found by the caller.
Matcher state that the caller owns.

simplesect.para: The result, the diff, and the number of replacements.

briefdescription.para: Writes a line with each match replaced, and reports the number of replacements.

detaileddescription.para: After an empty match, the search moves forward by one code point, so a character is never split and the same position is not matched again.

parameterdescription.para: The text that receives the replaced line.
The line to replace, without its line ending.

simplesect.para: The result, and the number of matches that were replaced.

briefdescription.para: Appends the replacement of one match: the replacement text, or the replacement tokens with the captured groups.

parameterdescription.para: The text that receives the replacement.
The captured groups of the match. Group 0 is the whole match.
